title: Pure Shaddoll
summary: Shaddoll cards with Void Unleashing, Mathematician and generic staples. Every Shaddoll Flip monster also triggers when a card effect sends it to the GY, so the Fusion Spells turn their materials into searches, mills and removal, and the El Shaddoll Fusions each cover one Attribute. The Glorious Gallery cards lead: Lev Shaddoll Fusion swaps one Fusion for another, Tohushaddoll Grysta Fusion Summons from the GY when it is milled, and El Shaddoll Meshahrail is the boss that searches Shaddoll cards and Void Unleashing. The page writes Meshahrail as "Meshachrer" and Wendikurhu as "Wendikuruhu"; the TCG names are used here.

allow.Void Unleashing: Glorious Gallery Spell from the page's combos: adds two Shaddoll cards; Meshahrail searches it.

main: Newest support. Flip: copies a Shaddoll's flip effect; milled by an effect, Fusion Summons from the GY.
Flip: destroys a monster; milled, mills another Shaddoll.
Flip: bounces a card; milled, destroys a Spell/Trap.
Flip or milled: summons a Shaddoll from the Deck.
Flip: draws two; milled, draws one.
Flip: searches a Shaddoll Spell/Trap; milled, searches a Shaddoll monster.
Flip: returns a banished Shaddoll; milled, banishes three cards from the GYs.
Flip: summons a Shaddoll from the hand.
Flip: protects a Shaddoll; milled, shuts off a monster's effects.
Generic: Normal Summoned, mills a Level 4 Shaddoll, as the page's second line does.
Newest support. Sends a Fusion to the GY, and Tributes a Fusion to summon a Shaddoll Fusion of another Attribute.
Fusion Summons a Shaddoll, from the Deck if they summoned from the Extra Deck.
Quick-Play Shaddoll Fusion on either turn.
Newest support. Reveals a Shaddoll to add two more of different card types, then discards.
Fusion Summons from the GY and sends their monster of that Attribute to the GY.
extra: Newest support. Shaddoll + DARK + EARTH: unaffected by their Spells/Traps and lower-Level monsters; searches each turn.
Newest support. Shaddoll + WIND: flips monsters face-down on either turn.
Two Shaddolls: negates a card; sent to the GY, searches.
Shaddoll + DARK: one Special Summon per turn for each player.
Shaddoll + LIGHT: mills a Shaddoll and destroys Special Summoned attackers.
Shaddoll + EARTH: negates a Special Summoned monster's effect.
Shaddoll + FIRE: negates a Special Summon.
Shaddoll + WIND: protects a monster in battle.
